leftEvidence.role: The Father who sees in secret
leftEvidence.title: Giving is tested by its audience

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus warns against doing merciful deeds before people in order to be seen.
points.right: Jesus contrasts prayer for public notice with prayer behind a closed door and warns against vain repetition.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Public reward is contrasted with hidden giving and the Father who sees in secret.
points.right: The Father sees in secret and already knows what is needed before the request.

payload.posture: Both practices are tested by the difference between human notice and the Father who sees.

rightEvidence.role: The Father who sees in secret
rightEvidence.title: Prayer is separated from display and many words

payload.tension: Prayer adds the problem of many words and the Father’s prior knowledge.
payload.title: One hidden audience for giving and prayer
